candidate.answerReason: Green gum drops are 25% of the total, so there are 120 gum drops. Replacing half the blue gum drops with brown increases the brown share from 20% to 35%, giving 42 brown gum drops.

methods.label: Find the total and update the brown share
methods.explanation:
The four listed percentages total
\[
30\%+20\%+15\%+10\%=75\%.
\]
Green therefore accounts for the remaining \(25\%\). Since there are \(30\) green gum drops, the total number is
\[
30\div0.25=120.
\]
Each removed blue gum drop is replaced by one brown gum drop, so the total stays \(120\). Half of the blue share is \(30\%\div2=15\%\) of that total. The new brown share is consequently \(20\%+15\%=35\%\), giving
\[
0.35\cdot120=\boxed{42}
\]
brown gum drops, choice C.
